items.rationale: Genuine theft damage on the recovered bike is covered under 2.3.1(b) and 7.1.1(b). All mobility repair and recovery lines exceed the EUR 500 aggregate sub-limit (4.2.2), so roughly 300 is scaled by about 0.46.
Theft damage to the brakes is a repair cost under 7.1.7. About 145 is scaled rateably under the EUR 500 sub-limit.
A tracking device that was not itself taken or damaged is excluded by 4.2.3 and 3.1.7.
This is servicing of an unaffected item, excluded by 3.1.6, 7.1.5 and 7.1.8(a)(b).
These are protective and supplementary items bought in connection with the loss, excluded by 4.2.3 and 3.1.7.
Carriage of parts for the covered repair falls under 7.1.7(f). About 26 is scaled rateably under the sub-limit.
Attendance for the covered repair falls under 7.1.7(g). About 75 is scaled by the sub-limit factor.
Fitting the replacement frame and brakes is part of the repair under 7.1.7(c). About 115 is scaled rateably.
Sundries could in principle fall under 7.1.7(e), but this line type was never paid before and is mostly treated as unspecified. Any amount would be tiny after scaling.
Labour on the covered repair counts under 7.1.7(d), though the invoice mixes in excluded work. A low rate of about 30 is scaled rateably.
Skilled labour for the frame and brake repair counts under 7.1.7(d). About 42 is scaled under the sub-limit.
Attendance at the find location is a recovery cost under 5.2.2(a), but references show low acceptance. About 50 is scaled rateably by the shared EUR 500 sub-limit.

items.description: Cut and remove seized lock (2 pcs)
items.rationale: Cutting the seized lock is a recovery cost under 5.2.2(b). About 110 is scaled by the sub-limit factor.
The second call-out is not shown to be required by the recovery, so it is excluded under 7.1.8(f) and (g).
A third-party release charge is covered under 5.2.2(c): 100 plus VAT is 119. It is scaled rateably within the EUR 500 mobility sub-limit.
Claim-processing and administration charges are excluded by 3.1.5 and 7.1.8(d).
Labour of every grade on the lock removal counts under 5.2.2(b). About 36 is scaled rateably.
Skilled labour on the recovery counts under 5.2.2(b); the reference rate is 35 to 40. About 40 is scaled rateably.
